name: Sack of Supplies
summary: A caravan shipment bound for Rezlak lies scattered among the harpy roosts of Razorwind Canyon. Dustwind harpies intercepted the goods as they crossed Durotar.

sections.title: A Plundered Caravan
sections.body: Rezlak needs steady supplies for his work outside Orgrimmar. The goblin engineer, contracted from Ratchet by Gazlowe, builds for the Horde. A caravan carrying a promised shipment passed near the canyon road south of Orgrimmar, where Dustwind harpies ambushed it. They dragged the cargo into their roosts in Razorwind Canyon, scattering sacks among dirt and scree beside their nesting sites.

faq.q: What is inside these supply sacks?
faq.answer: The sacks hold construction materials and trade goods for Gazlowe's engineering work, meant to support Orcish building projects near Orgrimmar. Without them, Rezlak has no supplies to finish his work.
Dustwind harpies stole the supplies. They are a savage avian race that infests the high crevices and ravines of Razorwind Canyon.
Rezlak is a goblin engineer Gazlowe sent from Ratchet to help the Horde build and maintain line infrastructure in Durotar.

angles.text: Recovering the supplies from local predators helps keep frontier construction around Orgrimmar moving without costly delays.
